about: Every kept layout of the layout library with the fields the page filters on (typology, entrance, density as a storey band 1-3 or 4+, storeys, MW), and for each candidate lot the row numbers (in layouts) of the kept layouts that fit it. There is no single best layout: the page picks the most-MW layout among those that pass the user's filters. totals: per city and band, the lots reached and the summed lot MW (the most-MW layout of that band on each lot). Counted from the files; nothing typed.
